tier1_postgresql.purpose: real multi-connection transactional acceptance, owner-authority, ambiguity, history reconciliation, physical PITR and relocation-fence evidence

tier2_timescale.purpose: candidate tenant-isolation, background-job, fresh-cluster restore, authenticated relocation-checkpoint and bounded capacity-profile falsification

classification_basis.final_package_gate_requirement: The exact final package HEAD, including this manifest and reviewer documentation, must independently rerun both gates before review/acceptance.
classification_basis.note: The empirical anchor includes immutable observation-content and owner-authority repairs, durable live poll claims, contiguous/current late-history reconciliation from the supported history floor, fresh-cluster Timescale restore/role reconstruction, lock-before-F source fencing, target-owned authenticated sealed checkpoints, SHA-256 canonical-payload equivalence and seal-vs-DML serialization.

codex_findings: target completeness receipt was not authenticated against current actual target state before activation
relocation digest covered identity/ordinal but not the immutable canonical observation payload
native_assurance_panorama_extensions: seal must serialize against target DML before measuring the checkpoint set
freeze must protect both OLD and NEW tenant authority scopes for cross-tenant UPDATE
projection writer must not own or be able to disable the target freeze authority

late_history_evidence.coverage_semantics: only overlapping/touching reconciliation windows form continuous coverage; a later disjoint window cannot jump an unswept interval
late_history_evidence.high_only_negative_vector: 11:55..12:00 sweep left anchored reconciliation coverage NULL and could not finalize
late_history_evidence.disjoint_negative_vector: supported_history_floor..10:00 plus 11:55..12:00 left contiguous coverage at 10:00 even though max(window_to)=12:00; finalization rejected
late_history_evidence.bridge_vector: 10:00..12:00 sweep closed the gap, recovered the delayed 10:30 observation and established contiguous coverage through 12:00
late_history_evidence.snapshot_currentness_negative_vector: finalization requiring reconciliation snapshot >=12:16 was rejected when covering sweeps were only current through 12:15
late_history_evidence.unrecoverable_retention_loss: explicit durable gap; never false complete

relocation_evidence.source_fence_derivation: placement authority locked before F is derived
relocation_evidence.source_inflight_acceptance_race: acceptance holding placement lock commits before fence and is included in F
relocation_evidence.negative_gap_vector: target reached max=F with missing lower rows; authenticated measurement remained incomplete and activation was rejected
relocation_evidence.canonical_payload_negative_vector: target retained the same identities/ordinals but a changed observed_at; SHA-256 canonical-payload digest differed and receipt remained incomplete
relocation_evidence.canonical_payload_fingerprint: SHA-256 over ordered accepted_ordinal, observation_id, metric_definition_id, normalized UTC observed_at and normalized numeric_value for the evidence observation profile
relocation_evidence.projection_writer: ts_automation_owner with projection DML but without checkpoint-table/key ownership or freeze-disable authority
relocation_evidence.checkpoint_attestation: HMAC-SHA-256 over domain-separated target-owned checkpoint facts
relocation_evidence.checkpoint_seal: target_control transitions open -> sealed before Tier 1 activation; there is no unseal path
relocation_evidence.seal_dml_serialization: target DML holds target_control FOR SHARE and seal holds FOR UPDATE before digest calculation; post-lock concurrent mutation blocks and then rejects
relocation_evidence.cross_tenant_freeze: UPDATE locks and validates both OLD and NEW tenant control scopes in deterministic tenant order

crypto_evidence_boundary.sha256_and_hmac_sha256: selected only as the bounded evidence mechanism needed to prove collision-resistant canonical-set comparison and authenticated target checkpoint semantics
crypto_evidence_boundary.production_requirement: the implementation must preserve an independently trustworthy target attestation/freeze authority and equivalent or stronger integrity semantics under the separately accepted security/platform key-management architecture

required_security_shape: no direct tenant-facing privilege on shared raw history
no direct tenant-facing privilege on continuous aggregate or internal materialization
tenant binding outside caller-writable SQL state
separate NOLOGIN mediation/checkpoint owner and least-privilege LOGIN automation owner
tenant-facing/runtime roles have no owner membership, CREATEROLE, SUPERUSER or BYPASSRLS
projection writer cannot read target attestation key or disable the sealed target-history freeze
backup/restore role topology is reconstructed in a fresh cluster rather than inherited from the source cluster
same isolation attacks repeat after background jobs, fresh-cluster restore and restored-job execution

bounded_capacity_observation.interpretation: Mechanism-level bounded fitness evidence only. These values are not production SLOs, limits, retention settings, cardinality envelopes or sizing commitments. Production envelopes remain OPEN-REL-020 C3.

decision_recommendation.tier1: accept PostgreSQL transactional acceptance/outbox/current-state pattern as OPEN-REL-030 Tier 1 mechanism only with immutable canonical observation content, owner-controlled source generation/epoch, durable live poll-claim admission resolved in-transaction, contiguous/current reconciliation coverage anchored at the supported history floor, lock-before-F relocation fencing, and verification of a target-owned authenticated sealed canonical-payload checkpoint, after exact-head review and explicit Track B acceptance
decision_recommendation.tier2: accept TimescaleDB historical projection only under the conformed mediated shared-history profile, including fresh-cluster restore role reconstruction and target-owned authenticated sealed relocation checkpoints whose SHA-256 canonical-payload set matches the frozen Tier 1 authoritative set, after exact-head review and explicit Track B acceptance
rejected_assumptions: do not treat RLS on a pooled raw hypertable as automatically compatible with or inherited by columnstore/continuous-aggregate surfaces
do not treat same-cluster database restore as evidence that cluster-global role topology can be safely reconstructed
do not derive relocation F before acquiring the authority lock that excludes later source acceptance
do not treat max(target_ordinal)=F as proof that every authoritative observation through F exists on the target
do not trust caller-supplied target count/digest/max as proof of the target's current actual state
do not fingerprint only message identity/ordinal when canonical payload equivalence is required
do not measure a target checkpoint before acquiring the authority lock that serializes target DML
do not allow UPDATE to escape a sealed tenant by checking only the NEW tenant authority scope
do not let the projection writer own or disable the freeze mechanism that makes a checkpoint current through activation
do not treat max(reconciliation window_to) as proof of contiguous history coverage from supported_history_floor
do not reuse reconciliation windows older than the snapshot currentness required by finalization
decision_recommendation.reversibility: Tier 2 remains behind the telemetry projection seam; replacement must preserve canonical observation identity and payload, idempotent historical projection, contiguous/current reconciliation evidence, independently trustworthy target checkpoint/freeze semantics, tenant isolation and recovery/relocation semantics
